description:
Accelerate New Offering Design and Time to Market: Manage the order fulfillment lifecycle across enterprise systems-including billing, shipping, and workforce management while also managing and tracking service fulfillment activities across activation and inventory applications.

OSM is an order processing system that takes as input an order from a customer relationship management (CRM) system, and manages the fulfillment functions that need to be carried out to complete the order. 
Fulfillment functions include operations such as assigning a phone number, activating a service on the network, shipping a phone, and running billing.

Product information page: https://docs.oracle.com/communications/E96856-01/doc.74/e96918/cpt_overview.htm#OSMCN306

labeler.rationale: Describes order and service fulfillment across billing, shipping, workforce, activation, and inventory systems, with operational steps such as assigning numbers and activating service; these are conventional workflow functions.
evidence_spans: Manage the order fulfillment lifecycle across enterprise systems-including billing, shipping, and workforce management
Fulfillment functions include operations such as assigning a phone number, activating a service on the network, shipping a phone, and running billing.

blind.rationale: Describes order intake and deterministic fulfillment coordination across billing, shipping, workforce, activation, and inventory systems.

manages the fulfillment functions that need to be carried out to complete the order.
assigning a phone number, activating a service on the network, shipping a phone, and running billing

parent_concerns: Blind asserts deterministic order coordination without stated implementation. Ground conventional support in described fulfillment operations, not invented determinism. Source URL is text only; do not fetch it.

description:

Nuance Recognizer delivers seamless self-service and an enhanced customer experience, with lower costs. Choose the market-leading automated speech recognition engine for more life-like, personalized customer interaction, driven by advanced AI.
